rules: This is the order in which the WRITER changes (risk, readiness, rollback). It is not the execution order (data_ownership.execution_order): an input Brain keeps serving its consumers from its own working direct writer until its step
A Brain may be CENTRAL only when every earlier step is CENTRAL, unless the cutover document carries an orderReviewRef (PL-10: changing the order requires explicit review)
A BLOCKED Brain can never be CENTRAL
biological-state may be CENTRAL only as the legacy combined unit (legacyCombinedAck: true)
